ranking_note: Authored from the current descriptions at base commit 725ee9f101 and frozen with no description rewrite (Plan B: cases and probes only); protocol per /playbooks:skill-authoring ## Measurement. actionlint:setup is excluded as a competitor because it is user-invoked only (disable-model-invocation: true). Competitors are bash-format:check and markdown-format:check (the same hook-prerequisite check for another plugin), harness-ops:prerequisites (missing tools across the whole enabled fleet) and toolchain:lint (running a linter, which check never does). check owns the read-only report on whether actionlint and node resolve for the actionlint hook, so install requests and lint runs are negatives. Hook-notice probes paraphrase the notice as text in the request.
